football_evidence.question: Can SMU’s pass rush get to Jackson Brousseau?
football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 1.9 points.
supporting: In his last two games (Boston College and Virginia), Jennings averaged 6.2 yards per attempt, against 11.4 in his four games before that.
contradicting: When SMU has the ball (big plays through the air): SMU’s offense turns 12.2% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and California’s defense gives up explosive gains on 15.7% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.3%).

When SMU has the ball (big plays on the ground): SMU’s offense turns 8.2% of its runs into explosive gains, and California’s defense gives up explosive gains on 10.5% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.6%).

When SMU has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): SMU’s offense has allowed a sack on 3.2% of its dropbacks, and California’s defense sacks the quarterback on 6.5% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).
When SMU has the ball (the passing game against the pass defense): SMU’s offense averages 9.0 yards per pass attempt, and California’s defense allows 8.0 yards per pass attempt (FBS average 7.4).
quarterbacks: Kevin Jennings has completed 140 of 193 passes (72.5%) for 1,859 yards, 9.6 yards per attempt, 16 touchdowns and 5 interceptions in six games for SMU, and has been sacked on 7 of 200 dropbacks.

Jaron-Keawe Sagapolutele has completed 121 of 180 passes (67.2%) for 1,310 yards, 7.3 yards per attempt, 9 touchdowns and 5 interceptions in six games for California, and has been sacked on 7 of 187 dropbacks.

Jackson Brousseau has completed 74 of 121 passes (61.2%) for 662 yards, 5.5 yards per attempt, 3 touchdowns and no interceptions in five games for California, and has been sacked on 4 of 125 dropbacks.
